latHint: Think a mild oath - not a tennis score.
pivHint: DEUCE means forty-all in tennis - but 'what the DEUCE' stands in for 'what the' what?
winText: Oh my. DEUCE was the pivot - forty-all to the DEVIL.
lossText: DEVIL - the evil one. DEUCE was the pivot: tennis DEUCE to the mild oath 'the DEUCE'.
